name: Chandanadi
subtitle: Sandalwood & Neem Cooling Oil
tagline: From India's Roots to Your Roots.
description: An exquisite, calming elixir crafted to cool the scalp and restore natural balance. Chandanadi merges the soothing, fragrant tranquility of Sandalwood with the deeply purifying and protective qualities of Neem. Steeped in a hydrating coconut base and enriched with grounding Vetiver roots, this traditional formulation dispels excess heat, comforts irritated skin, and leaves hair with a natural, healthy luster and a lingering, sacred aroma.

ingredients.name: Sandalwood Chips
ingredients.role: Cools the scalp, pacifies excess heat, and provides a soothing, sacred fragrance

ingredients.name: Neem Leaves
ingredients.role: Purifies the scalp and combats dandruff and irritation

ingredients.name: Vetiver Roots
ingredients.role: Grounds the blend and provides an earthy, cooling effect

ingredients.name: Coconut Oil
ingredients.role: Nourishing, cooling base that deeply conditions and hydrates

whyThisHerb: Sandalwood is celebrated for its unmatched ability to pacify heat and soothe an irritated scalp, while Neem provides the essential purification needed to keep roots healthy and free of flakiness.

howToUse.title: Apply
howToUse.description: Part your hair and apply the oil directly to your scalp, focusing on areas that feel warm or irritated.

howToUse.title: Massage
howToUse.description: Using gentle, circular motions with your fingertips, massage the oil deeply into the scalp to encourage absorption.

howToUse.title: Rest
howToUse.description: Allow the cooling botanical blend to rest for at least 30 to 45 minutes to deeply soothe the roots.

howToUse.title: Rinse
howToUse.description: Wash thoroughly with a mild herbal shampoo. Use twice a week to maintain a balanced, calm scalp.
